title: Enabling Engram for a project does not reach an already-loaded Codex thread: resume overrides are ignored until a cold resume
outcome: Observed on the Mac host, 2026-11-22. Comovo's project (project-2, github.com/aolowko/fit_friends) was enabled for Engram with Execution Observability at about 03:50Z: Verify 200, PATCH 200, control-policy 200. The running root session Mac::Comovo (session-6211, Codex CLI/app-server 0.169.0, thread 01a1e002-c866-73e1-95d7-43e43250189a) still had no Engram MCP tools and no ENGRAM_HOME, ENGRAM_ACTOR_ID or ENGRAM_SESSION_ID. Codex logged at 03:42:30Z: "resume_running_thread: thread/resume overrides ignored for loaded thread …: config overrides were provided and ignored while running". A fresh read-only child (session-6214, delegation-778d3d64-4e2c-40c9-8484-89f74dec48d6) received the tools and the environment, and its next(peek) and show both returned isError:false. So an operator enabling Engram gets no effect in the already-open session, and TermAl doesn't say so.
acceptance: After a project's Engram enablement changes, a root Codex session whose provider thread is already loaded either receives the Engram MCP tools and environment at its next turn, or TermAl shows the operator that the session needs a resume to receive them. A behaviour test covers the loaded-thread case.

completion.summary: Landed and installed the cold-resume notice for attached and previously stopped root Codex threads. It gives the operator a same-project fresh-session workaround. The real-stop regression passed in the 95/95 Central focused run with verification ad602725aa9d44a0b6b3f6a12644aeec. Both R2 reviews were clean; the exact DL560 full gate and independent acceptance 9a192e2aec78477db793e6d91e340754 passed. Opus2 confirmed install at 04:48:06Z with binary SHA-256 DC5A03BCAA13BAAB391DFE1C1F74165E0C5A19C1926798E18691EA7B32A837B2 (install note d793d2c4bdd849afb540d5e759bd4931). The running host requires the coordinated restart to use it.
